_meta.how_to_regression_diff: Re-run (npm run check:golden wardrobe-chaos-helper) with dev backend up. Diff for QUALITY not exact match: HTTP 200. 2026-09-14: GROUND-UP REWRITE — response shape changed completely on all 3 endpoints. Main gen: outfit_combinations[] (with outfit_id, comfort_rating, style_rating, sensory_friendly, weather_appropriate, confidence_boost, color_coordination) -> outfits[] {role: best_fit|easiest|alternative, items, why_today, check} + top-level just_dress_me (one-line, no alternatives). getting_dressed_tips/backup_option/capsule_wardrobe_suggestions all REMOVED — the tool no longer assigns style/comfort scores, invents a 'Sensory OK'/'Weather OK' badge, manufactures confidence-boost affirmations, treats color coordination as mandatory, or suggests purchases automatically. Regenerate: outfit.why_this_works/comfort_rating/etc -> outfit.items/why_today/check (same fact/style discipline). Pack: packing_list[]/outfit_plan[]/tips[] -> pack_these[] (bare item names, no reuse_count objects)/wear_plan[]/uncertainty (singular, explicitly required to flag unverified destination weather rather than inventing climate). GUARDS: (1) main gen guard now keys outfits[] (non-empty) + just_dress_me (both top-level, always present) — NOT outfit_combinations. (2) 'alternative' role is OPTIONAL — the prompt explicitly says omit it rather than force a weak third option; a thin wardrobe can legitimately return only 2 outfits, and best_fit/easiest can legitimately be identical when the wardrobe doesn't support two distinct combinations (verified live, DE, 5-item wardrobe). Do not treat 2-outfit responses or best_fit==easiest as a regression. (3) items.accessories is an ARRAY, not a string/null like the other item slots — the frontend's flatItems()/render logic depends on this; do not collapse it back to a bare string. (4) no-inner-double-quote rule still required on all 3 prompts. (5) PF-2 aliases (labelText already in c block + c.textMuteded + c.label) still required. (6) mood is now OPTIONAL on all 3 endpoints — do not resurrect a 400 on missing mood. (7) pack must never invent destination climate — uncertainty should name the unverified weather when none was supplied (verified live: 'Berlin im Winter' correctly produced an uncertainty note, not an invented climate assumption). (8) truncation: pack max_tokens 4000, wear_plan capped at numDays (<=14), pack_these effectively capped by the wardrobe size — verified live: 14-day Berlin trip, 10 items, 14-day wear_plan, no truncation. DO NOT reverse: the deletion of comfort_rating/style_rating/confidence_boost/color_coordination/sensory_friendly/weather_appropriate/getting_dressed_tips/backup_option/capsule_wardrobe_suggestions from all 3 schemas; the optional 'alternative' role; the no-inner-quote rules; the PF-2 aliases; mood being optional; the pack uncertainty-over-invented-climate rule.
_meta.known_issues: accessories is an array in every items object, unlike the other single-value slots — frontend must handle both shapes when rendering or flattening items.

outfits.why_today: Der blaue Pullover passt zur kühlen Witterung und zum Arbeitskontext. Die Kombination ist praktisch, bietet guten Komfort und unterstützt das Gefühl von Ruhe durch einfache, gedeckte Töne.
Identisch mit best_fit: höchste Komfortwerte und minimale Entscheidungslast für einen kühl-beruflichen Tag.

output.just_dress_me: Blauer Pullover, Dunkle Jeans, Weiße Sneaker

outfit.why_today: Blauer Pullover und schwarze Hose ersetzen das weiße Hemd und die dunklen Jeans. Die dunkleren Farben passen besser zu kaltem, regnerischem Wetter. Braune Stiefel sind praktischer für Nässe als weiße Sneaker und unterstützen das Arbeitsszenario.
outfit.check: Die braunen Stiefel haben einen niedrigeren Komfortwert (6/10) als die weißen Sneaker. Falls die Füße während des Arbeitstages anfangen zu schmerzen, sind die weißen Sneaker trotz des feuchten Wetters die bessere Alternative.

output.uncertainty: Die Berliner Wintertemperaturen wurden nicht angegeben. Überprüfe die Vorhersage vor der Abreise — der Plan basiert auf der Annahme, dass die vorhandene Garderobe für deine Bedingungen ausreicht. Der blaue Blazer dient als einzige Außenschicht; zusätzliche wärmende Kleidung oder eine Jacke könnte notwendig sein, je nachdem wie kalt es wird.
